reading.body:
Virginia's tracked data center footprint is a single facility in Ashburn operated by Spanberger, with no reported megawatt capacity.

The record contains one facility and a total_mw of zero, so it offers no usable power figure for that site. That absence matters for AI because data center capacity is the physical layer behind compute, and without megawatts there is no basis to estimate grid load or compute scale.

The data does not say whether the Ashburn facility is operational, under construction, or planned, nor whether the zero is a true reading or a missing value. It covers only this one record and cannot be read as a measure of Virginia's overall data center capacity.
